text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: [ALERT] inference-queue-prod backlog > 95% (queue length: 12,300). Autoscaler lagging (controller: k8s-autoscaler). AlertID: A-63258-QR. Link: https://pd.example/INC63258

pagerduty-bot: PagerDuty incident triggered -> paging jess (oncall). Incident: INC-63258 (high). Escalation policy: eng-oncall. Pager details: https://pd.example/inc/INC-63258

jess: acked. I'm on it. pulling metrics now.

liam: looking at metrics — processing RPS down ~60%. autoscaler desiredReplicas stuck at 4 for 8m despite target=80. CPU target met but queue length grows.

omar: checking autoscaler logs. seeing "failed to modify scale: Admission webhook timed out" repeatedly. suspect control-plane delays.

jess: commands I'll try: 1) scale manually 2) check node provisioning 3) fallback config. Doing manual scale now.

liam: run:
```
kubectl -n prod scale deploy/inference-worker --replicas=12
kubectl -n prod get hpa inference-worker -o yaml
```

incident-bot: Action: manual scale requested by jess — replica count changed from 4 -> 12. (timestamp)

maya: after scale triggered, new pods pending for >90s. nodes pending provisioning. cloud API return: "InsufficientInstanceCapacity: We currently do not have sufficient capacity in the requested Availability Zone."

omar: that's the root cause — cloud couldn't provision nodes; autoscaler can't fulfill requests. Opening ticket with cloud infra. pinging @cloud-oncall.

sre-backup: temporary mitigation: cordon some low-priority nodes and move noncritical workloads, but we still need capacity quickly.

jess: enabling degraded-route for batch and fallback model for search to reduce pressure. patch:
```
routes:
  /search:
    fallback_model: small-llm
    priority: high
  /batch:
    rate_limit: 20rps
```

product-ops: customer impact: Spike in 503s for some orgs — observed 20-30% errors on chat endpoints, increased latency. Notifying status page.

pagerduty-bot: Incident INC-63258 escalated to Omar (SRE lead) due to capacity block. Secondary oncall: liam.

omar: cloud ticket opened (TICKET-9812), requested soft quota bump and AZ fallback. Also kicked off autoscaler controller restart:
```
kubectl -n infra rollout restart deploy/k8s-autoscaler
kubectl -n infra logs deploy/k8s-autoscaler -f
```

liam: autoscaler restart succeeded, controller now reports "scale request accepted". Cloud replied: launched 6 additional nodes in alternative AZs — pods are scheduling.

incident-bot: Queue length decreasing: 12,300 -> 4,200 -> 800 over 6 minutes. CPU usage normalized.

jess: verified core customer paths: search success rate improving, error rate down to 3%. Leaving manual replica count at 12 for now. Will plan a controlled rollback once stable.

maya: posting status update: "Degraded — mitigation in progress. Customers may experience higher latency" on status.redwood.ai

jess: marking incident as mitigated for paging. creating incident ticket INC-63258 and will run postmortem. tagging owners: omar/liam/jess/maya. Adding action items: autoscaler webhook timeout handling, AZ fallback policy, alert tuning to include node provisioning health.

sre-backup: noted. handoff to next oncall at 6325889002.
